form_fields.name_help: Put your full name and in these boxes. Please do not use nicknames or initials. If this application is for a change of name you will be asked for your previous name in a later section. And don't forget to include your title (Mr., Mrs., Miss, Ms.). The pre-determined options for the Title field are dictated by the National Mail Voter Registration Form, and this field is required by some states. They are not reflective of Rock the Vote's views or values on gender inclusivity.
form_fields.home_address_help: Put your home address in these boxes. Do not put your mailing address here if it is different from your home address. Do not use a post office box or rural route without a box number. If you live in a rural area or do not have a street address, please show where you live using the map on the printed form.
form_fields.mailing_address_help: Put your home mailing in these boxes only if it is different from your home address. If you do not receive mail at your home address you must fill out this section to indicate where you can be reached by mail.
form_fields.changed_address_help: If you have moved since your last registration, enter your previous address.
form_fields.dob_help: On your voter registration application, you are required to indicate whether you will be 18 years old on or before election day. However, many states allow you to register before your 18th birthday, so see the rules for your state.
form_fields.phone_help: Most states ask for your telephone number in case there are questions about your application. You are not required to provide your phone number.
